{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version of biomarker_baseline where -999.0 is replaced with NaN
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check group balance by severity
arm_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['severity'])

# Stratify analysis by severity
# Calculate mean biomarker_final within each severity level, by arm
mean_biomarker_final_by_severity_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby(['severity', 'arm'], dropna=False)['biomarker_final'].mean().unstack(level='arm')

# Calculate response rate within each severity level, by arm
response_rate_by_severity_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby(['severity', 'arm'], dropna=False)['responded'].mean().unstack(level='arm')

# Compute difference within each severity stratum
diff_biomarker_final_by_severity = mean_biomarker_final_by_severity_arm['treatment'] - mean_biomarker_final_by_severity_arm['control']
diff_response_rate_by_severity = response_rate_by_severity_arm['treatment'] - response_rate_by_severity_arm['control']

# Print results
print('Mean biomarker_final by severity and arm:\n', mean_biomarker_final_by_severity_arm)
print('\nResponse rate by severity and arm:\n', response_rate_by_severity_arm)
print('\nDifference in biomarker_final (treatment - control) by severity:\n', diff_biomarker_final_by_severity)
print('\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by severity:\n', diff_response_rate_by_severity)"}
